title: Heathrow Rewards
overview: Heathrow Airport serves tens of millions of passengers annually and operates one of the most complex passenger ecosystems in the world. I led the redesign of the mobile app — transforming a legacy, fragmented experience into a coherent, contextual product used by 1.6 million passengers. The result: +50% unique users, +252% flights added, Gold at the Magellan Awards 2025.

sections.label: Challenge
sections.content: The existing Heathrow app was a legacy system with fragmented user journeys, limited contextual relevance, low loyalty programme engagement, and inconsistent UX patterns across features. The business needed a redesigned product that could increase passenger engagement and revenue — without compromising enterprise-grade accessibility, performance, or scalability. How might we design a mobile experience that reduces cognitive load in high-stress, time-sensitive environments, and scales across diverse passenger profiles and travel intents?

sections.label: Research & Discovery
sections.content: I mapped end-to-end passenger journeys across arrival, departure, transit, and dwell time — identifying friction clusters around loyalty visibility, flight status, and wayfinding. Analytics and funnel data revealed where users dropped off and which features were underused. Competitive benchmarking across leading loyalty and travel apps globally surfaced opportunities for progressive disclosure, contextual UX, and system thinking at scale.

sections.label: Design Process
sections.content: I followed a product-led UX process combining discovery, delivery, and optimisation — leading design end-to-end from problem framing to developer handover, across multiple squads. Key phases: (1) IA restructure based on passenger mental models, (2) Lo-fi to mid-fi flows tested with real users across 2 rounds, (3) Modular, accessible design system built for multi-squad consistency, (4) High-fidelity prototype for stakeholder sign-off and full dev handoff aligned to Heathrow brand standards.

sections.caption: Delivering one of the world's greatest airport experiences to 1.6M app users — Encora × Heathrow

sections.label: Solution
sections.content: A contextual, moment-led app experience meeting passengers exactly where they are — planning ahead, navigating the terminal, or discovering rewards. Core features redesigned: home dashboard with contextual offers, live flight tracker, digital loyalty card, personalised notifications, and in-terminal wayfinding. I also defined the AI UX vision for hyper-personalised interfaces — driving design system consistency across multiple product squads and partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, and AI teams throughout.

sections.caption: Travel Weekly Magellan Awards 2025 — Gold · Airport Overall Mobile App

sections.label: Reflection
sections.content: Working at Heathrow scale meant designing for one of the most demanding, diverse user bases in the world — millions of passengers from different cultures, under real time pressure. The most valuable lesson: contextual relevance beats feature richness. A notification at the right moment is worth ten screens of information. I'm proud that the work shipped, scaled, and won — but what stays with me most is seeing real passengers use it better.
